examples.en: We climb a hill to see the village.
It is fun to climb the Great Wall.
Don't climb the tree in the park.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 climb 手脚并用爬上长城或小山。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 climbs；过去式 climbed

examples.en: Sarah saw a gingerbread house in the story.
examples.zh: 萨拉在故事里看到了一座姜饼屋。

examples.en: The gingerbread house looks sweet and brown.
examples.zh: 姜饼屋看起来又甜又棕。

examples.en: Would you like to make a gingerbread house?

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：gingerbread 姜饼 + house 屋，gingerbread house 是姜饼屋。

examples.en: The bridge is about one kilometre long.
examples.zh: 这座桥大约长五十五公里。

examples.en: We walked one kilometre to the museum.
examples.zh: 我们走了一公里到博物馆。

examples.en: It is one kilometre from here to the park.
examples.zh: 从这里到巴黎有多少公里？

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：kilo 千 + metre 米，kilometre 是千米、公里。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 kilometres

examples.en: My cousin lives in New Zealand.
New Zealand has beautiful mountains and lakes.
We learn about New Zealand in our English book.
examples.zh: 我们在英语书里了解新西兰。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：New 新 + Zealand 西兰，New Zealand 是新西兰。

examples.en: I will send a postcard to my friend.
examples.zh: 我要给朋友寄一张明信片。

examples.en: Please send me an email after the trip.
She will send photos from Paris tomorrow.
examples.zh: 她昨天从巴黎寄来了照片。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：send 音近「送」，send a postcard 就是邮寄发送。
语义联想：I will send a postcard. send 是邮寄、发送。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 sends；过去式 sent

definitions.text: be 的过去式（第一、三人称单数）

examples.en: The weather was sunny last week.
It was an inspiring trip.
examples.zh: 那是一次鼓舞人心的旅行。

examples.en: The museum was very interesting.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 was 把现在的 is 推回到过去。

reveal.inflectionNote: be 动词过去式（第一、三人称单数）；复数过去式 were

examples.en: We took photos in front of the Eiffel Tower.
examples.zh: 我们在埃菲尔铁塔前拍了照。

examples.en: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, France.
examples.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔在法国巴黎。

examples.en: The Eiffel Tower looks amazing at night.
examples.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔在夜晚看起来很壮观。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Eiffel 埃菲尔 + Tower 塔，Eiffel Tower 是埃菲尔铁塔。

examples.en: The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge is very long.
We read about the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上读到港珠澳大桥。

examples.en: Many people visit the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge.
examples.zh: 许多人参观港珠澳大桥。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Hong Kong 香港 + Zhuhai 珠海 + Macao 澳门 + Bridge 桥，港珠澳大桥。

examples.en: Paris is the capital of France.
I want to visit Paris one day.
We saw the Eiffel Tower in Paris.
examples.zh: 我们在巴黎看到了埃菲尔铁塔。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：Paris 音近「巴黎」，Paris 就是巴黎。
语义联想：Paris is the capital of France. Paris 是巴黎。

examples.en: The Terracotta Warriors are made of clay.
She made a small bowl from clay.
examples.zh: 她用陶土做了一只小碗。

examples.en: Clay can be shaped into many things.
examples.zh: 陶土可以塑造成很多东西。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 clay 陶土在手中捏成陶俑。

examples.en: We go to the museum on Saturday.
Let's go and see the Terracotta Warriors.
They go to New Zealand every year.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 go 背着包走向机场或博物馆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 goes；过去式 went

examples.en: I want to see the Eiffel Tower.
We see a beautiful view from the hill.
examples.zh: 我们从山上看到了美丽的景色。

examples.en: Did you see the Red Army uniform in the museum?
examples.zh: 你在博物馆看到红军制服了吗？

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 see 眼睛看到埃菲尔铁塔或兵马俑。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 sees；过去式 saw

examples.en: The Terracotta Warriors are in Xi'an.
We learned about the Terracotta Warriors today.
examples.zh: 我们今天学习了兵马俑。

examples.en: Thousands of Terracotta Warriors stand in rows.
examples.zh: 成千上万的兵马俑排列站立。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：terracotta 陶 + warriors 战士，Terracotta Warriors 是兵马俑。

examples.en: There are one thousand warriors in the museum.
examples.zh: 博物馆里有成千上万的俑。

examples.en: The bridge is fifty-five thousand metres long.
A thousand people visited the site last month.
examples.zh: 上个月有一千人参观了遗址。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 thousand 兵马俑排成成千上万行。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 thousands

examples.en: The weather was hot and dry in summer.
Keep the clay dry before you paint it.
examples.zh: 上色前让陶土保持干燥。

examples.en: It is dry in the north in winter.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 dry 沙漠里太阳晒得地面干干的。

examples.en: We eat at a restaurant near the airport.
examples.zh: 我们在机场附近的餐馆吃饭。

examples.en: What did you eat in Macao?
Let's eat pumpkin soup for dinner.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We eat at a restaurant. eat 是吃。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 eats；过去式 ate

examples.en: We take photos at every famous place.
examples.zh: 我们在每个名胜都拍照。

examples.en: It can take two hours to get to the museum.
Please take your bag to the airport.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 take photos 举起相机拍照。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 takes；过去式 took

examples.en: The view from the hill is wonderful.
We enjoyed the view of the ocean.
There is a great view of Paris from the tower.
examples.zh: 从塔上可以看到巴黎的美景。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 view 站在山顶俯瞰村庄景色。

examples.en: They live in a small village in the mountains.
examples.zh: 他们住在山里的小村庄。

examples.en: The village is quiet and beautiful.
We visited a village near Jinggangshan.
examples.zh: 我们参观了井冈山附近的一个村镇。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 village 小村庄里有梯田和竹林。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 villages

examples.en: We arrived at the airport early.
The airport is busy during the holiday.
Take a taxi from the airport to the hotel.
examples.zh: 从机场乘出租车去酒店。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：air 航空 + port 港，airport 是机场。

examples.en: There is green bamboo around the village.
Pandas eat bamboo every day.
We saw bamboo forests on the trip.
examples.zh: 我们在旅途中看到了竹林。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 bamboo 绿竹成林，熊猫在吃竹子。

examples.en: The story of the Red Army is inspiring.
It was an inspiring visit to the museum.
examples.zh: 参观博物馆是一次鼓舞人心的经历。

examples.en: Her speech was inspiring to all of us.
examples.zh: 她的演讲鼓舞了我们所有人。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：inspire 鼓舞 + ing，inspiring 是鼓舞人心的。

examples.en: We visited the Jinggangshan Revolution Museum.
examples.zh: 我们参观了井冈山革命博物馆。

examples.en: The Jinggangshan Revolution Museum tells an important story.
examples.zh: 井冈山革命博物馆讲述了一段重要的历史。

examples.en: Students learn history at the Jinggangshan Revolution Museum.
examples.zh: 学生们在井冈山革命博物馆学习历史。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Jinggangshan 井冈山 + Revolution 革命 + Museum 博物馆。

examples.en: We ate pumpkin soup at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们在餐馆喝了南瓜汤。

examples.en: The pumpkin is big and orange.
Farmers grow a pumpkin in the village.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 pumpkin 橙色大南瓜摆在餐馆门口。

examples.en: We had lunch at a small restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们在一家小餐馆吃了午饭。

examples.en: The restaurant near the airport is clean.
examples.zh: 机场附近的餐馆很干净。

examples.en: This restaurant serves good food.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 restaurant 旅行后坐下来吃饭。

examples.en: We learned about the Red Army at the museum.
examples.zh: 我们在博物馆了解了红军。

examples.en: The Red Army marched through the mountains.
The story of the Red Army is inspiring.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：the Red 红色 + Army 军队，the Red Army 是红军。

examples.en: The gala will begin at seven o'clock.
When does the book fair begin?
Let's begin our rehearsal now.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 begin 晚会倒计时后节目开始。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 begins；过去式 began

examples.en: Three teachers will judge the singing contest.
examples.zh: 三位老师担任歌咏比赛的评委。

examples.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.
The judge chose the winner yesterday.
examples.zh: 评委昨天选出了获胜者。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Teachers judge the contest. judge 是评判、裁判。

examples.en: See you later after the race.
We can read the notice later.
She will paste the poster later.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：See you later. later 是后来。

examples.en: There is a notice about the book fair.
examples.zh: 有一张关于书展的通知。

examples.en: Please read the notice on the board.
Did you see the notice for the gala?
examples.zh: 你看到晚会的通知了吗？

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Read the notice on the board. notice 是通知。

examples.en: I wake up early on festival days.
Wake me up before the countdown.
She will wake up excited tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 她昨天早上醒来很激动。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Wake up early on festival days. wake 是醒来。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 wakes；过去式 woke

examples.en: Our class can win the singing contest.
examples.zh: 我们班赢得了歌咏比赛。

examples.en: Who will win the marathon?
Work hard and you can win.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Our class won the contest. win 是获胜。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 wins；过去式 won

examples.en: The winner got a book from the fair.
examples.zh: 获胜者从书市赢得一本书。

examples.en: She is the winner of the race.
The winner wore a red dress on stage.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：win 赢 + er 的人，winner 是获胜者。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 winners

examples.en: Have you ever been to a book fair?
This is the most exciting gala ever.
examples.zh: 这是最令人激动的一场晚会。

examples.en: Did you ever sing at a school gala?
examples.zh: 你在学校晚会上唱过歌吗？

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Have you ever been to a book fair? ever 是以往任何时候。

examples.en: Paste the notice on the wall.
We paste pictures on the poster.
examples.zh: 我们把图片贴在海报上。

examples.en: Can you paste these labels for me?
examples.zh: 你能帮我把这些标签贴上吗？

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Paste the poster on the wall. paste 是粘贴。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 pastes；过去式 pasted

examples.en: Let's count down from ten to one.
They count down to the New Year.
We count down before the fireworks.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：count 数 + down 向下，count down 是倒计时。

examples.en: She will dress up for the gala.
The children dress in red for the festival.
Please dress warmly for the marathon.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Dress up for the gala. dress 是穿衣服、打扮。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 dresses；过去式 dressed

examples.en: Our school holds a gala every autumn.
examples.zh: 我们学校每年秋天举办晚会。

examples.en: The gala was exciting last night.
Many students sing at the gala.
examples.zh: 许多学生在晚会上唱歌。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 gala 舞台上灯光、歌声和欢呼。

examples.en: She works as a writer for the school paper.
We cheer as the runners pass by.
examples.zh: 运动员经过时我们欢呼。

examples.en: Use red paper as a background.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She works as a writer. as 是作为。

examples.en: There is a book fair in our school.
I bought two books at the book fair.
The book fair begins on Monday.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：book 书 + fair 集市，book fair 是书市。

examples.en: We cheer for our classmates in the race.
The crowd cheer loudly at the gala.
examples.zh: 观众在晚会上大声欢呼。

examples.en: Cheer up! You can win next time.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cheer 音近「起儿」，观众 cheer 欢呼加油。
语义联想：Cheer for our team. cheer 是欢呼、加油。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 cheers；过去式 cheered

examples.en: He ran in a marathon last year.
The marathon is forty-two kilometres long.
examples.zh: 马拉松全长四十二公里。

examples.en: Many runners join the marathon in spring.
examples.zh: 春天很多人参加马拉松。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：来自希腊 Marathon 地名，marathon 是马拉松赛跑。

examples.en: The race will start at nine o'clock.
Our team won the relay race.
Don't run too fast at the start of the race.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：race 音近「瑞斯」，race 赛跑比速度。
语义联想：The race starts at nine. race 是赛跑。

examples.en: They run every morning before school.
examples.zh: 他们上学前每天早上跑步。

examples.en: She can run very fast in the race.
examples.zh: 她在赛跑中能跑得很快。

examples.en: Let's run to the finish line together.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：They run in the marathon. run 是跑、奔跑。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 runs；过去式 ran

examples.en: We make posters for the book fair.
She can make everyone cheer at the gala.
examples.zh: 她让晚会上每个人都欢呼起来。

examples.en: Let's make a countdown clock together.
examples.zh: 我们一起做一个倒计时钟吧。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Make posters for the fair. make 是做、使。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 makes；过去式 made

examples.en: I read a story by a famous writer.
examples.zh: 我读了一位著名作家写的故事。

examples.en: Please read the notice carefully.
We read books at the book fair.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Read the notice carefully. read 是阅读。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 reads；过去式 read /red/

examples.en: We sing songs at the Mid-Autumn gala.
examples.zh: 我们在中秋晚会上唱歌。

examples.en: She can sing very well on stage.
Let's sing together after the race.
examples.zh: 比赛结束后我们一起唱吧。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We sing at the gala. sing 是唱、演唱。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 sings；过去式 sang

examples.en: We wear new clothes for the festival.
She can wear a red dress at the gala.
Runners wear numbers on their shirts.
examples.zh: 赛跑选手在衬衫上戴号码。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Wear new clothes for the festival. wear 是穿、戴。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 wears；过去式 wore

examples.en: The writer came to our book fair.
examples.zh: 那位作家来到我们的书市。

examples.en: I want to be a writer when I grow up.
The writer read a story to us.
examples.zh: 作家给我们读了一个故事。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：write 写 + er 的人，writer 是作家。

examples.en: We had an exciting gala yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们昨天举办了一场令人激动的晚会。

examples.en: Yesterday was the last day of the book fair.
examples.zh: 昨天是书市的最后一天。

examples.en: She won the race yesterday.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：yester 昨日 + day 日，yesterday 是昨天。

examples.en: The countdown to the New Year is exciting.
It was an exciting marathon.
examples.zh: 那是一场令人激动的马拉松。

examples.en: The gala was very exciting.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：excite 使激动 + ing，exciting 是令人激动的。

examples.en: I have a cold and a runny nose.
Stay warm so you don't catch a cold.
She stayed home because of a cold.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 cold 感冒时纸巾和 runny nose。

examples.en: My head hurts when I have a fever.
Rest your head on the pillow.
The doctor checked my head and throat.
examples.zh: 医生检查了我的头和喉咙。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：My head hurts. head 是头部。

examples.en: I have a runny nose and need a tissue.
A runny nose is common when you have a cold.
Drink warm water if you have a runny nose.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：runny 流淌的 + nose 鼻子，runny nose 是流鼻涕。

examples.en: You will feel better soon.
The doctor will call you back soon.
examples.zh: 医生很快会给你回电话。

examples.en: I hope the fever goes down soon.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：You will feel better soon. soon 是很快、马上。

examples.en: He is ill and cannot go to school.
She felt ill after staying up late.
Call the doctor if you feel ill.
examples.zh: 如果觉得不舒服就给医生打电话。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：He is ill today. ill 是有病的、不舒服的。

examples.en: Cover your mouth when you cough.
He has a bad cough and a fever.
Warm soup helps when you cough.
examples.zh: 咳嗽时喝点热汤有帮助。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Cover your mouth when you cough. cough 是咳嗽。

examples.en: She has a fever and needs to rest.
The fever went down after he took medicine.
Call me if your fever gets higher.
examples.zh: 如果烧得更高就给我打电话。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：fever 音近「非热」，发烧 fever 体温升高。
形象联想：想象 fever 体温计水银柱升高。

examples.en: Let's discuss a healthy diet in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上讨论健康饮食。

examples.en: The doctor and I discuss my cough.
examples.zh: 医生和我讨论我的咳嗽。

examples.en: We discuss how to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 我们讨论如何保持健康。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：dis 分开 + cuss 议论，discuss 是讨论。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 discusses；过去式 discussed

examples.en: A good diet helps you stay healthy.
examples.zh: 良好的饮食帮你保持健康。

examples.en: Add more vegetables to your diet.
We talk about diet when someone is ill.
examples.zh: 有人生病时我们会谈饮食。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：A good diet keeps you healthy. diet 是日常饮食。

examples.en: Don't stay up too late when you are ill.
He stayed up and felt unhappy the next day.
examples.zh: 他熬夜了，第二天心情很不好。

examples.en: Staying up late can make you feel ill.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：stay 保持 + up 醒着，stay up 是熬夜。

examples.en: Add some honey to warm water.
The doctor can add a note to my email.
examples.zh: 医生在我的邮件里补充了一条说明。

examples.en: Add fruit to your diet every day.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Add honey to warm water. add 是增加、补充说。

examples.en: Take another glass of water, please.
Another day of rest may help you feel better.
examples.zh: 再休息一天也许你会好些。

examples.en: Let's discuss another way to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 我们再讨论一种保持健康的方法吧。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：an 一 + other 其他，another 是另一个。

examples.en: I feel better today than yesterday.
examples.zh: 我今天比昨天感觉好些。

examples.en: Rest in bed and you will get better soon.
examples.zh: 卧床休息，你很快就会好转。

examples.en: Warm soup makes my throat feel better.
examples.zh: 热汤让我的喉咙舒服些。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I feel better today. better 是好转的、更好的。

reveal.inflectionNote: good/well 的比较级

examples.en: Call the doctor if the fever is high.
examples.zh: 如果烧得高就给医生打电话。

examples.en: I will call you soon.
My mum can call the clinic this morning.
examples.zh: 我妈妈今天早上给诊所打了电话。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Call the doctor. call 是（给……）打电话。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 calls；过去式 called

examples.en: The little boy can cry when his head hurts.
Don't cry. You will feel better soon.
examples.zh: 别哭，你很快就会好起来。

examples.en: She can cry because she feels ill.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Don't cry. cry 是哭。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 cries；过去式 cried

examples.en: Send an email to ask about your cough.
examples.zh: 发邮件询问咳嗽的情况。

examples.en: I got an email from the nurse.
examples.zh: 我收到护士发来的邮件。

examples.en: Please email me when you feel better.
examples.zh: 你好些了请给我发邮件。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Send an email to the nurse. email 是电子邮件。

examples.en: Drink a glass of warm water.
She drank juice from a glass.
Put the medicine in a glass of water.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：glass 音近「格拉斯」，a glass 可以指一杯或玻璃。
语义联想：glass 表示「一杯（的量）」，结合本课例句记忆。

examples.en: You may stay home if you are ill.
examples.zh: 如果生病你可以待在家里。

examples.en: It may rain, so take a coat.
May I call the doctor for you?
examples.zh: 我可以帮你给医生打电话吗？

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：You may stay home. may 是也许、可能。

examples.en: He feels unhappy when he is ill.
Staying up late made her unhappy.
Don't be unhappy. You will get better.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：un 不 + happy 快乐，unhappy 是不快乐的。

examples.en: We watched a video about a healthy diet.
examples.zh: 我们看了一段关于健康饮食的视频。

examples.en: The nurse sent a short video to my email.
examples.zh: 护士往我的邮箱发了一个短视频。

examples.en: This video shows how to wash your hands.
examples.zh: 这个视频演示如何洗手。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Watch a video about health. video 是视频、录像。

examples.en: I don't have enough money for the ticket.
How much money do you need?
She saved money in a jar.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 money 硬币掉进攒钱 jar 里。

examples.en: I get pocket money every month.
He uses pocket money to buy a ticket.
Save your pocket money for the book fair.
examples.zh: 把零花钱攒起来买书展的书。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：pocket 口袋 + money 钱，pocket money 是零花钱。

examples.en: My schoolbag is too heavy.
She put the ticket in her schoolbag.
I need a new schoolbag for school.
examples.zh: 我需要一个新书包上学。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：school 学校 + bag 包，schoolbag 是书包。

examples.en: Would you like a drink?
A drink is on sale today.
Don't buy too much sugary drink.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Would you like a drink? drink 是饮料。

examples.en: The shop sells many different goods.
examples.zh: 这家店卖许多不同的商品。

examples.en: These goods are half price today.
Check the goods before you pay.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The shop sells many goods. goods 是商品。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数形式；单数 good 指商品较少用

examples.en: A haircut costs twenty yuan here.
He wants a haircut before the gala.
Good service at the haircut shop.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：hair 头发 + cut 剪，haircut 是发型、理发。

examples.en: The shop has good service.
Thank you for your kind service.
Bad service makes customers unhappy.
examples.zh: 服务差会让顾客不高兴。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The shop has good service. service 是服务。

examples.en: You're lucky to get a half-price ticket.
examples.zh: 你能买到半价票真幸运。

examples.en: I feel lucky to find this book.
examples.zh: 能找到这本书我觉得很幸运。

examples.en: Lucky customers get a free drink.
examples.zh: 幸运顾客能获赠一杯饮料。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：You're lucky to get a ticket. lucky 是幸运的。

examples.en: We use a microscope in science class.
examples.zh: 我们在科学课上用显微镜。

examples.en: The microscope is difficult to use at first.
examples.zh: 显微镜一开始用起来很难。

examples.en: Look at the leaf under the microscope.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：micro 微 + scope 看，microscope 是显微镜。

examples.en: There is a big sale in the market.
These shoes are on sale today.
The book fair has books on sale.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：sale 音近「售哦」，sale 是特价出售。
语义联想：Books are on sale. sale 是特价销售。

examples.en: I save up for a new schoolbag.
She saves up her pocket money every week.
examples.zh: 她每周把零花钱攒起来。

examples.en: It takes time to save up enough money.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：save 存 + up 起来，save up 是攒钱。

examples.en: I bought a ticket for the show.
The ticket is half price for students.
Don't lose your ticket.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：ticket 音近「提客」，ticket 是票。
语义联想：Buy a ticket for the show. ticket 是票。

examples.en: It is difficult to save up a lot of money.
The maths problem is difficult.
Managing money is not difficult with a plan.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Saving money is difficult. difficult 是困难的。

examples.en: We reuse bottles, for example old water bottles.
examples.zh: 我们重复使用瓶子，例如旧水瓶。

examples.en: You can save money, for example by buying on sale.
examples.zh: 你可以省钱，例如买特价商品。

examples.en: Eat healthy food, for example vegetables and fruit.
examples.zh: 吃健康食物，例如蔬菜和水果。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：for 为了 + example 例子，for example 是例如。

examples.en: Half of my pocket money goes into the jar.
examples.zh: 我一半零花钱放进罐子里。

examples.en: The ticket is half price today.
I ate half of the apple.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Half price today. half 是一半。

examples.en: Put your coins in a jar to save up.
The jar on my desk is full.
She opened the jar and counted the money.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 jar 玻璃罐里装满攒下的 pocket money。

examples.en: Learn to manage your pocket money.
She can manage the shop with her mum.
examples.zh: 她和妈妈一起管理店铺。

examples.en: It is important to manage time well.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Manage your pocket money. manage 是管理。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 manages；过去式 managed

examples.en: They sell drinks and snacks at the fair.
examples.zh: 他们在集市卖饮料和零食。

examples.en: The shop can sell goods at a good price.
We sell old books to save up money.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：They sell drinks at the fair. sell 是卖、售卖。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 sells；过去式 sold

examples.en: There is a white cloud in the sky.
A cloud covers the moon tonight.
We see a cloud from the spaceship window.
examples.zh: 我们从飞船窗口看到云。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 cloud 白云飘过 sky 遮住 sun。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 clouds

examples.en: We can see the sun in the daytime.
The rover works in the daytime on Mars.
examples.zh: 探测器在火星白天工作。

examples.en: Daytime on the moon is very bright.
examples.zh: 月球上的白天非常明亮。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：day 日 + time 时间，daytime 是白天。

examples.en: The earth goes around the sun.
Astronauts see the earth from space.
We must protect the earth.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Protect the earth. earth 是地球。

examples.en: He collects a colourful marble.
The boy lost his marble under the bed.
examples.zh: 男孩把弹珠掉到床底下了。

examples.en: A marble is a small glass ball.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：He collects marbles. marble 是弹子、弹珠。

examples.en: The moon is bright tonight.
Taikonauts walked on the moon.
We learn about the moon in science class.
examples.zh: 我们在科学课上学月球。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 moon 夜空中明亮的圆月。

examples.en: The ocean covers much of the earth.
examples.zh: 海洋覆盖了地球的大部分。

examples.en: Blue ocean water looks beautiful from space.
examples.zh: 从太空看蓝色海水很美。

examples.en: Fish live in the ocean.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Fish live in the ocean. ocean 是海洋。

examples.en: Taikonauts travel into outer space.
examples.zh: 航天员进入外太空旅行。

examples.en: There is no air in outer space.
We learn about outer space in this unit.
examples.zh: 本单元我们学习外太空。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：outer 外层 + space 空间，outer space 是外太空。

examples.en: Earth is our planet.
Mars is a red planet.
Earth is a planet in our solar system.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Earth is our planet. planet 是行星。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 planets

examples.en: Stars shine in the night sky.
The sky turns orange at sunset.
Look at the sky through the telescope.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Stars shine in the sky. sky 是天空。

examples.en: There is a lot of space in outer space.
examples.zh: 外太空里有广阔的空间。

examples.en: We read books about space.
Space travel is exciting.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We learn about space. space 是太空、空间。

examples.en: Chinese taikonauts work on the space station.
examples.zh: 中国航天员在空间站工作。

examples.en: The space station goes around the earth.
We read about the space station in Unit 5.
examples.zh: 我们在第五单元读到空间站。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：space 太空 + station 站，space station 是空间站。

examples.en: We see a star at night.
examples.zh: 夜晚我们看到许多星星。

examples.en: The North Star is easy to find.
A star is a ball of burning gas.
examples.zh: 恒星是一团燃烧的气体球。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：star 音近「斯达」，night sky 里的 star 是星。
语义联想：Stars shine at night. star 是恒星、星。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 stars

examples.en: A satellite goes around the earth.
China launched a satellite into space.
examples.zh: 中国向太空发射了许多卫星。

examples.en: The satellite sends photos to us.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：satell 伴随 + ite，satellite 是绕行星运行的人造卫星。

examples.en: Children imagine an alien from another planet.
examples.zh: 孩子们想象来自其他行星的外星生物。

examples.en: Is there an alien in the story?
Scientists search for signs of an alien in space.
examples.zh: 科学家在太空中寻找外星生命的迹象。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Children imagine aliens. alien 是外星生物。

examples.en: The rover explores Mars.
Mars looks red in the sky.
examples.zh: 火星在天空看起来是红色的。

examples.en: Scientists want to learn more about Mars.
examples.zh: 科学家想了解更多关于火星的知识。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：Mars 音近「马斯」，Mars 是火星。
形象联想：想象 Mars 红色星球上 rover 在行驶。

examples.en: The rover collects soil on Mars.
examples.zh: 探测器在火星上采集土壤。

examples.en: A rover can drive on another planet.
examples.zh: 探测器可以在另一颗行星上行驶。

examples.en: Photos from the rover are amazing.
examples.zh: 探测器传回的照片很惊人。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 rover 在 Mars 上采集 soil 样本。

examples.en: Plants need soil and water.
The rover tested the soil on Mars.
examples.zh: 探测器检测了火星上的土壤。

examples.en: Good soil helps crops grow.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Plants need soil. soil 是土壤。

examples.en: We watched the sunrise on the hill.
Sunrise comes early in summer.
The sky is pink at sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出时天空是粉红色的。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sun 太阳 + rise 升起，sunrise 是日出。

examples.en: The astronaut waved from the spaceship.
examples.zh: 航天员在宇宙飞船上挥手。

examples.en: An astronaut needs long training before flying into space.
examples.zh: 航天员进入太空前需要长期训练。

examples.en: The astronaut looked at the earth from the space station.
examples.zh: 航天员从空间站看地球。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：astro 星星 + naut 航行者，astronaut 是宇航员。

examples.en: The taikonaut went into outer space.
Look into the telescope carefully.
Water flows into the bottle.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Go into outer space. into 是进入。

examples.en: It can take a month to travel to Mars.
We learn one new unit each month.
examples.zh: 我们每月学一个新单元。

examples.en: Last month we read about the moon.
examples.zh: 上个月我们读了关于月球的内容。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：It takes months to reach Mars. month 是月。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 months

examples.en: The taikonaut flew in a spaceship.
examples.zh: 航天员乘宇宙飞船飞行。

examples.en: The spaceship left the earth at sunrise.
examples.zh: 宇宙飞船在日出时离开地球。

examples.en: A spaceship needs a lot of power.
examples.zh: 宇宙飞船需要大量能源。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：space 太空 + ship 船，spaceship 是宇宙飞船。

examples.en: Use a telescope to see the stars.
The telescope is in the science room.
He looked at Mars through a telescope.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：tele 远 + scope 看，telescope 是望远镜。

examples.en: Wipe the telescope with a clean cloth.
The taikonaut wore a special cloth suit.
examples.zh: 航天员穿着特殊的布料宇航服。

examples.en: A soft cloth keeps the lens clean.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Wipe with a clean cloth. cloth 是布。

examples.en: I have a question about outer space.
examples.zh: 我有一个关于外太空的问题。

examples.en: The teacher answered our question.
examples.zh: 老师回答了我们的问题。

examples.en: Ask a question if you don't understand.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I have a question about space. question 是问题。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 questions

examples.en: The sunset looks beautiful over the ocean.
We took photos at sunset.
The sky turns red at sunset.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sun 太阳 + set 落下，sunset 是日落。

examples.en: The taikonaut spoke to students from space.
examples.zh: 航天员从太空给学生们讲话。

examples.en: A taikonaut is famous around the world.
A taikonaut needs long training.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：taikong 太空 + naut 航行者，taikonaut 是中国航天员。

examples.en: What time do you read this book?
It is time to learn about space.
One more time, please.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：How many times have you read it? time 是次、回。

examples.en: Put toothpaste on your brush.
We need to buy toothpaste at the market.
Don't waste toothpaste.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：tooth 牙 + paste 膏，toothpaste 是牙膏。

examples.en: We use electricity every day at home.
Turn off the light to save electricity.
Electricity powers the air conditioner.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：electric 电的 + ity 名词，electricity 是电。

examples.en: Solar power comes from the sun.
The spaceship needs a lot of power.
examples.zh: 宇宙飞船需要大量能源。

examples.en: Wind can give us power too.
examples.zh: 风也能给我们提供能源。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：power 音近「泡儿」，power 是驱动机器的能源力量。
语义联想：Solar power comes from the sun. power 是能源、力量。

examples.en: The air conditioner keeps the room cool.
It feels cool after the shower.
Reuse bottles — that's a cool idea.
examples.zh: 重复使用瓶子——这主意很酷。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cool 音近「酷」，天气 cool 凉爽，也很酷。
语义联想：The room stays cool. cool 是凉爽的。

examples.en: The sun is a source of energy.
We should save energy at home.
examples.zh: 我们应该在家节约能源。

examples.en: Food gives us energy to run and study.
examples.zh: 食物给我们跑步和学习的能量。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Save energy at home. energy 是能源、能量。

examples.en: The sun gives us heat and light.
Heat the water before you shower.
Close the window to keep in the heat.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The sun gives heat and light. heat 是加热、热量。

examples.en: Turn off the light when you leave.
Sunlight is a useful source of light.
The room is full of light in the daytime.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Turn off the light. light 是光。

examples.en: Solar energy is clean and useful.
We learn about solar power in science.
examples.zh: 我们在科学课上学太阳能。

examples.en: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity.
examples.zh: 太阳能板把阳光变成电。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sol 太阳 + ar，solar 是太阳的。

examples.en: The sun is a source of light and heat.
Water is an important source for life.
Find the source of the problem.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The sun is a source of energy. source 是来源。

examples.en: What type of energy do you use?
There is one type of resource.
This type of bottle is easy to reuse.
examples.zh: 这种瓶子容易重复使用。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：What type of energy? type 是类型、种类。

examples.en: We can change habits to save energy.
examples.zh: 我们可以改变习惯来节约能源。

examples.en: Light can change into heat.
A small change can make a big difference.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Change habits to save energy. change 是改变。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 changes；过去式 changed

examples.en: There is a big difference between heat and light.
Reuse makes a difference to the environment.
examples.zh: 重复使用对环境有影响。

examples.en: Can you see the difference?

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：differ 不同 + ence，difference 是差别。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 differences

examples.en: Few people drive to the market on foot.
We have a few bottles to reuse.
examples.zh: 我们有几个瓶子可以重复使用。

examples.en: Only a few lights are on now.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Only a few lights are on. few 是不多、很少。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 fewer；最高级 fewest

examples.en: Take a quick shower to save water.
Unplug the TV for a quick way to save power.
examples.zh: 拔掉电视插头是快速省电的方法。

examples.en: She gave a quick answer to the question.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Take a quick shower. quick 是迅速的、快的。

examples.en: Water is an important natural resource.
We must protect earth's resource.
examples.zh: 我们必须保护地球的资源。

examples.en: Reduce, reuse and save a resource.
examples.zh: 减少、重复使用并节约资源。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：re 再 + source 来源，resource 是可利用的资源。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 resources

examples.en: We should save energy before resources run out.
examples.zh: 资源用完前我们要节约能源。

examples.en: The oil may run out one day.
examples.zh: 石油有一天可能会用完。

examples.en: Don't run out of clean water at home.
examples.zh: 别在家把干净水用完了。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：run 跑/运行 + out 出，run out 是用完。

examples.en: Take a short shower to save water.
I take a shower every morning.
The shower uses both water and energy.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 shower 喷头洒下热水。

examples.en: Unplug the air conditioner when you go out.
Remember to unplug the charger.
Unplug the TV to save electricity.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：un 取消 + plug 插头，unplug 是拔插头。

examples.en: We use the air conditioner in summer.
Turn off the air conditioner to save energy.
The air conditioner makes the room cool.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：air 空气 + condition 调节 + er，air conditioner 是空调。

examples.en: Reuse this bottle instead of buying a new one.
examples.zh: 重复使用这个瓶子，别买新的。

examples.en: Fill the bottle with water.
A plastic bottle can pollute the earth.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 bottle 洗干净后 reuse 装水。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 bottles

examples.en: My dad can drive to the market.
Drive less and walk more to save energy.
examples.zh: 少开车多走路来节约能源。

examples.en: The rover can drive on Mars.
examples.zh: 探测器可以在火星上行驶。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Drive less to save energy. drive 是驾驶。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 drives；过去式 drove

examples.en: We buy fruit at the market.
The market sells many types of goods.
Let's go to the market on Sunday.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：market 音近「马keit」，market 是买卖东西的集市。
语义联想：Buy fruit at the market. market 是市场。

examples.en: I have my own water bottle.
Use your own bag when you shop.
examples.zh: 购物时用你自己的袋子。

examples.en: Every family can own useful things at home.
examples.zh: 每家都有自家有用的东西。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I have my own bottle. own 是自己的。

examples.en: Reduce waste to protect the earth.
We reduce power use by turning off lights.
examples.zh: 我们通过关灯减少用电。

examples.en: Reduce, reuse, recycle — three useful ways.
examples.zh: 减少、重复使用、回收——三种有用的方法。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Reduce waste. reduce 是减少。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 reduces；过去式 reduced

examples.en: Reuse old bottles at home.
Reuse bags when you go shopping.
It is useful to reuse things.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：re 再 + use 使用，reuse 是重复使用。

examples.en: The bottle is dirty. Wash it before reuse.
examples.zh: 瓶子脏了，重复使用前先洗一洗。

examples.en: Do not throw dirty water into the river.
Your hands are dirty. Go and wash them.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 dirty bottle 要先洗才能 reuse。

examples.en: Put the jar on the other side of the table.
examples.zh: 把罐子放在桌子另一边。

examples.en: The shop is on the left side of the street.
Look at each side before you cross.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：On the other side of the table. side 是一面、一边。

examples.en: Put the top on the bottle before you reuse it.
examples.zh: 重复使用瓶子前先盖上盖子。

examples.en: The top shelf is hard to reach.
examples.zh: 最上面的架子很难够到。

examples.en: He got the top score in the English test.
examples.zh: 他英语测验得了最高分。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象把 top 盖在 bottle 上，或站在 top 层书架。

examples.en: Solar energy is useful and clean.
This is a useful way to save electricity.
English is useful when you travel.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：use 使用 + ful 充满，useful 是有用的。
